mapper.select: select s.id, s.type, s.name, s.icon from im_session s join im_session_member m on s.id = m.session_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.is_exit = 0
select id, name, icon, type from im_session where type = #{sessionEnum} and name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') limit 20
mapper.insert: insert into im_session(type, name, icon) values (#{type}, #{name}, #{icon})
